text_block_list.text:
I came to the shrine with Tamamo Cross, 
who was in a slump.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"God, I'm real sorry for only turnin' to 
ya when it's convenient! But bad stuff 
keeps happenin', and I'm at my wit's end!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Please! Here's hoping my condition goes 
up!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Tama-chan. It's unusual to run into 
you at a shrine.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Man, my luck's been so bad lately I 
thought I was cursed, so I had to rely on 
a little divine intervention.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh... in that case, please let me join you 
in prayer as well~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Please... Take all my good luck and give 
it to Tama-chan~!!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"I don't care what happens to me, so 
please, just make them happy...!!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: No, you're exaggerating way too much!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, sawry~♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
But I really do want them to get better. I 
hope they start feeling well soon.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I appreciate the thought. Thanks 
for praying with me.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hm? ...Say what?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, what's wrong~? Tama-chan.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Looks like I won tickets to an amusement 
park in an online sweepstakes!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I just applied on the off chance, but I 
can't believe it actually worked out!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"It's all thanks to Creek prayin' together 
with me!! The little ones're gonna be 
thrilled!!"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That's wonderful~. By the way, about that 
amusement park... would it be alright if I 
joined you?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ye're super welcome!! This is gonna be a 
blast!!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Pampering Tama-chan's little sister 
and brother to my heart's content... I'm 
really getting fired up.

Perhaps as a divine blessing from the 
shrine visit, Tamamo Cross's condition 
began to improve from that day on.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'm heading back to the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ack! I stepped in gum!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh dear. We need to clean this up quickly.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Gum comes off easily when you freeze it~. 
I have some cooling spray, so leave it to 
me.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... sorry about this, Creek... I owe 
you one...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Please don't worry about it. I'm just 
happy that you relied on me, Tama-chan.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I guess if ya don't pray regularly, the 
gods ain't gonna help ya out when ya need 
it...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Cheer up! Even if bad things happen from 
now on, I'll take care of it somehow~!

Super Creek was kind to her, but Tamamo 
Cross remained in a slump afterward.
